Products that score “E” have a higher impact and are therefore key products to focus our efforts to improve their environmental performance.</div><a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/sustainability-2025/ecobeautyscore"><div class="ebs-layout__bottom-links">Click here to learn more</div></a></div></div></div><div class="cp-row"><div class="col-6"><img src="https://images-1.eucerin.com/~/media/eucerin%20relaunch%20media/eucerin/international/sustainability-and-responsibility/components/icons/int_en_ecn_sicon_sustainability_clean_formulations_icon_05_2021_pr.png" alt=""/><div class="sustainability-information-section__text cp-text-s">Free of Microplastics (according to UNEP definition)</div></div><div class="col-6"><img src="https://images-1.eucerin.com/~/media/eucerin%20relaunch%20media/eucerin/international/sustainability-and-responsibility/components/icons/int_en_ecn_sicon_sustainability_sourcing_icon_05_2021_pr.png" alt=""/><div class="sustainability-information-section__text cp-text-s">Foldingbox made of FSC certified paper</div></div></div></div></div></section><section class="pdp-about-section uk-section"><div class="cp-row"><div class="description cp-container"><div><div class="fixed-container"><p class="title cp-text">About</p><div class="scrollable-content"><div class="text cp-text"><div>A clinically tested, ultra light skin perfecting serum containing Thiamidol to reduce pigment spots and prevent their reappearance. Suitable for all skin types, this serum absorbs quickly and helps skin to look even, refined and with a natural radiant glow.</div><span class="legal-label cp-text-s">NART: 98350-09900-27</span></div><div><div class="accordion-jss"><div class="accordion-jss__title cp-text" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion-content"><p>Read more about our product</p><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M19.6363 15.8181L11.9999 8.18175L4.36353 15.8181" stroke="#222222"></path></svg></div><div id="accordion-content" class="accordion-jss__content cp-text">More radiance and less pigmentation Melanin is a natural pigment that gives colour to skin. Exposure to <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/about-skin/basic-skin-knowledge/sun-and-the-skin" target="">sunlight</a>, hormonal influences and ageing can cause an increase in melanin production and trigger hyperpigmentation. <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/skin-concerns/uneven-skin/hyperpigmentation" target="">Hyperpigmentation</a> appears as dark patches and <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/about-skin/indications/age-spots" target="">age spots</a> (also known as <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/about-skin/indications/age-spots" target="">sun spots</a>) that make skin look uneven.  Eucerin Anti-Pigment Skin Perfecting Serum combines powerful active ingredients that work in different ways to promote your skin’s radiance and reduce hyperpigmentation at the source: <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/our-research/ingredients/t/thiamidol" target="">Thiamidol</a> is an effective and patented ingredient that acts at the root cause of hyperpigmentation is clinically proven to reduce hyperpigmentation, preventing its reappearance with regular usage. Patented to Eucerin. Hyaluronic Acid is one of our skin’s most effective moisturising substances that helps skin to attract and retain moisture, while <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/our-research/ingredients/g/glycerin" target="">Glycerin</a> is a humectant which also helps our skin to attract and retain water, giving long-lasting moisturisation and care. Together, these ingredients ensure your skin can have the hydration and moisture it needs to achieve a beautiful glow. 
Crystal technology ensures an ultralight texture that’s suitable for all skin types and can be added to any skincare routine. It absorbs quickly and leaves skin with a smooth feeling. 
The serum is clinically and dermatologically proven to reduce pigment spots and prevent their reappearance while giving your skin more radiance. First results are visible after two weeks and improve continuously with regular use. Skin is smooth and looks even, refined and with a natural radiant glow.</div></div></div></div></div><template id="P:2"></template></div></div><template id="P:3"></template></div></section><section class="pdp-main-findings-section cp-container uk-section"><div class="cp-row cp-row-center"><div class="cp-section-content"><div class="title-container"><p class="title hdl-3">Main findings</p><div class="tooltip-wrapper" data-module="Tooltip"><span class="tooltip-info-icon"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="12" height="13" viewBox="0 0 12 13" fill="none"><rect y="0.5" width="12" height="12" rx="6" fill="#223341"></rect><path d="M5.25 4.26066C5.25 4.04739 5.31164 3.8673 5.43493 3.72038C5.56279 3.57346 5.75 3.5 5.99658 3.5C6.23858 3.5 6.42352 3.57346 6.55137 3.72038C6.68379 3.8673 6.75 4.04739 6.75 4.26066C6.75 4.46446 6.68379 4.63981 6.55137 4.78673C6.42352 4.92891 6.23858 5 5.99658 5C5.75 5 5.56279 4.92891 5.43493 4.78673C5.31164 4.63981 5.25 4.46446 5.25 4.26066Z" fill="white"></path><path d="M6.5 6.5V10.5H5.5V6.5H6.5Z" fill="white"></path></svg></span><div class="tooltip-content cp-text-s uk-drop uk-drop-top-left">*Clinical study, score improvement compared to baseline, self-grading, 38 subjects, 12 weeks of use twice daily.
**IQVIA Consumer Health Sell-Out data regarding sales value and volume based on 16 countries, MAT 08/2023</div></div></div><div class="cp-row"><div class="col-6"><div class="percentage cp-text">100%</div><div class="text cp-text">Radiance*</div></div><div class="col-6"><div class="percentage cp-text"></div><div class="text cp-text">THIAMIDOL® #1 solution for dark spots**</div></div></div></div></div></section><section class="pdp-ingredients-section cp-container uk-section" id="pdp-ingredients-section" data-anchor-navigation-title="pdp-ingredients-section"><div class="description"><h3 class="hdl-3">Clinical Formula</h3> <div class="key-ingredients grid-mode"><div class="key-ingredients-grid cp-row"><div class="key-ingredient-item col-6"><div class="key-ingredients__content"><div class="hdl-4">Thiamidol</div><div class="cp-text-m"><p>Thiamidol is a patented ingredient, known to fight hyperpigmentation acting at its root cause. It works by inhibiting the human tyrosinase, the key enzyme in melanin production. Hyperpigmentation can be the result of different causes, e.g. sun-induced dark spots, post-blemish marks or age spots. Key benefits are:
</p>
<p>Reduction of Hyperpigmentation: By effectively inhibiting tyrosinase, Thiamidol decreases melanin synthesis, leading to a visible reduction in dark spots and an even skin tone.
</p>
<p>Works on all skin types: Thiamidol is dermatologically tested and suitable for all skin types, including dry, oily, combination, normal and sensitive skin. It works for skin of any ethnicity or age and thus is effective on all skin types and tones.
</p>
<p>Fights post-blemish marks: Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation happens when skin is inflamed or injured, for example because of blemishes. The impacted area is left darkened and hyperpigmented despite having otherwise healed. Thiamidol addresses these areas resulting in an even skin tone.</p></div><a class="key-ingredients__link cp-link-s" href="/our-research/ingredients/t/thiamidol">Learn More</a></div></div><div class="key-ingredient-item col-6"><div class="key-ingredients__content"><div class="hdl-4">Hyaluronic acid</div><div class="cp-text-m"><p style="margin: 2pt 2.85pt 2pt 0in;">Hyaluronic Acid is formed by skin cells and is part of the connective tissue of the skin. One of its key functions is to retain moisture, and it has the ability to bind in between 1,000 and 10,000 times its own weight in water (i.e. one gram binds between one and ten liters). As we age, the skin's natural ability to produce Hyaluronic Acid depletes and wrinkles start to form and deepen.</p></div><a class="key-ingredients__link cp-link-s" href="/our-research/ingredients/h/hyaluronic%20acid">Learn More</a></div></div></div></div><div class="pdp-ingredients-section__link-container"><div class="pdp-ingredients-section__main-link btn secondary-btn"> <!-- -->View all</div></div></div></section><section class="uk-section cp-container faq-section"><div class="cp-row cp-row-center"><div class="cp-section-content"><div class="title hdl-3">FAQ</div><div><div class="accordion-jss"><div class="accordion-jss__title cp-text" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion-content"><p>Can I use Eucerin Anti-Pigment Skin Perfecting Serum alongside other Eucerin moisturisers? </p><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M19.6363 15.8181L11.9999 8.18175L4.36353 15.8181" stroke="#222222"></path></svg></div><div id="accordion-content" class="accordion-jss__content cp-text"><p>Eucerin Anti-Pigment Skin Perfecting Serum can be used alone or integrated into any skincare routine. We recommend that you use Eucerin Anti-Pigment Skin Perfecting Serum twice a day, in the morning and evening.  <br />
<br />
If you experience hyperpigmentation but it is not your primary skin-ageing concern, then you may want to apply Eucerin Anti-Pigment Skin Perfecting Serum before one of our anti-ageing care products such as: <br />
<br />
<a href="/products/hyaluron-filler/day-care-spf-30">Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler Day SPF 30</a>, which plumps up fine lines and deep wrinkles for a rejuvenated look <br />
<br />
<a href="/products/hyaluron-filler/hyaluron-filler-moisture-booster">Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler Moisture Booster</a> for an immediate moisture boost </p></div></div><div class="accordion-jss"><div class="accordion-jss__title cp-text" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion-content"><p>Can I use Eucerin Anti-Pigment Skin Perfecting Serum instead of a moisturiser?</p><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M19.6363 15.8181L11.9999 8.18175L4.36353 15.8181" stroke="#222222"></path></svg></div><div id="accordion-content" class="accordion-jss__content cp-text"><p><span style="color: #4e5c67; background-color: #ffffff;">Eucerin Anti-Pigment Skin Perfecting Serum contains concentrated </span><a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/our-research/ingredients/hyaluronic-acid" style="background-color: #ffffff;">Hyaluronic Acid</a><span style="color: #4e5c67; background-color: #ffffff;"> which improves skin moisturisation. It is effective when used individually, as part of your current skincare routine, or alongside other products in the </span><a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/products/anti-pigment" style="background-color: #ffffff;">Eucerin A</a><a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/products/anti-pigment" style="background-color: #ffffff;">nti-Pigment range</a><span style="color: #4e5c67; background-color: #ffffff;">. </span><br style="color: #4e5c67; background-color: #ffffff;" />
<br style="color: #4e5c67; background-color: #ffffff;" />
<span style="color: #4e5c67; background-color: #ffffff;">Eucerin Anti-Pigment Skin Perfecting Serum does not protect skin from the sun. As the sun’s rays are a key contributor to hyperpigmentation it’s important to wear an appropriate sun protection product, even on cloudy days. We recommend that, if you apply Eucerin Anti-Pigment Skin Perfecting Serum in the morning, you follow it with </span><a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/products/anti-pigment/day-cream" style="background-color: #ffffff;">Eucerin Anti-Pigment Day SPF 30</a><span style="color: #4e5c67; background-color: #ffffff;"> to help fade existing acne marks and protect skin from the sun, thereby reducing further sun-induced pigmentation issues. For intense sun exposure choose a higher protection factor from the </span><a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/products/sun-protection" style="background-color: #ffffff;">Eucerin Sun Protection range</a><span style="color: #4e5c67; background-color: #ffffff;">.</span></p></div></div><div class="accordion-jss"><div class="accordion-jss__title cp-text" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion-content"><p>How can I boost my skin’s radiance?</p><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M19.6363 15.8181L11.9999 8.18175L4.36353 15.8181" stroke="#222222"></path></svg></div><div id="accordion-content" class="accordion-jss__content cp-text"><p>Eucerin Anti-Pigment Skin Perfecting Serum can be used effectively as part of your regular skincare routine to make your skin more even and radiant. You can also adopt certain <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/skin-concerns/uneven-skin/how-to-get-radiant-skin-tips">self-care habits at home</a> to increase your skin’s glow. </p></div></div></div></div></div></section><template id="P:4"></template><template id="P:5"></template><template id="P:6"></template><section class="eucerin-cp cp-section cp-container uk-section releated-articles"><div><p class="headline-h2 hdl-2">Read also some related articles</p><template id="P:7"></template></div></section><div></div></div><div hidden id="S:3"><div class="media"><picture loading="lazy"><source srcSet="https://images-1.eucerin.com/~/media/eucerin%20relaunch%20media/media-center-items/e/8/6/a1cd5f33700f44eaa9dd821b1ac2c545-screen.jpg?db=web&mw=945&hash=15458540ca26cf10ea3021d82d9c2f91" media="(min-width: 1024px)"/><source srcSet="https://images-1.eucerin.com/~/media/eucerin%20relaunch%20media/media-center-items/e/8/6/a1cd5f33700f44eaa9dd821b1ac2c545-screen.jpg?db=web&mw=1023&hash=c193ba69a8f47020cc6e7466b5fabb18" media="(max-width: 1023px)"/><img loading="lazy" srcSet="https://images-1.eucerin.com/~/media/eucerin%20relaunch%20media/media-center-items/e/8/6/a1cd5f33700f44eaa9dd821b1ac2c545-screen.jpg?db=web&hash=e8d35370e6654dc349a34b1dc82f6d67" alt=""/></picture></div></div><script>$RS=function(a,b){a=document.getElementById(a);b=document.getElementById(b);for(a.parentNode.removeChild(a);a.firstChild;)b.parentNode.insertBefore(a.firstChild,b);b.parentNode.removeChild(b)};$RS("S:3","P:3")</script><div hidden id="S:4"><script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[[{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I use Eucerin Anti-Pigment Skin Perfecting Serum alongside other Eucerin moisturisers?
